title: Derivative close-out and Core collateral realisation are two effects
summary: Merchant close-out authority and Core collateral realisation authority are deliberately separate. A Merchant collateral candidate is not usable collateral until Core returns an exact control receipt; later realisation/cash movement must cross the arm’s-length Core perimeter.
invariants: Usable collateral requires a Core-issued control receipt matching agreement, asset, owner/provider, currency and controlled amount.
Merchant-side haircuts apply only after enforceable Core control exists.
Merchant default/close-out may create a settlement obligation but cannot directly post the Retail/Core Ledger.
Core independently decides asset existence, ownership, validity/enforceability, priority and controlled amount.

provenance.claim: Usable collateral requires exact Core control evidence; close-out and Core settlement remain separate.
